- memory_id "1000149": Oskar runs the weekly architecture review.  (about: Oskar, weekly architecture review)
- memory_id "1000140": The authentication gateway is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000136": The job scheduler is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000130": The reporting service is owned by the Dune team.  (about: Dune team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000105": Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000101": Farah has the first on-call rotation for the Dune team.  (about: Farah, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000094": The Ember team is a one-person team consisting of Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000050": Farah runs the Dune team solo until the next hire lands.  (about: Farah, Dune team)
